description: This Java class 'ModifySubjectsSubstitutionStrategy' handles substitution logic for 'Subjects' within a 'ModifySubjects' command object, used in policy enforcement or modification context within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ModifySubjectsSubstitutionStrategy
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractTypedSubstitutionStrategy, specialized for handling substitution of 'Subjects' in 'ModifySubjects' commands.

methods.name: ModifySubjectsSubstitutionStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the substitution strategy for 'ModifySubjects' type.
